summary: TOMI Environmental Solutions filed an 8-K solely to announce a one-for-three reverse stock split of its common and Series A preferred stock, effective July 20, 2026. No fractional shares will be issued; holders otherwise entitled to a fraction receive a full post-split share. The authorized share count remains unchanged, and outstanding options and warrants are proportionally adjusted. This is a routine capital structure event, not a special situation. No deal terms, recommendation, or special-situation dynamics apply. The filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activism, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other unusual corporate event.
